title: pm-spec tickets.json
description: A change's work items in a neutral format: for a change with several components, one epic for the change and one task per component; for a change with one component, one task with no parent (the change's own ticket). Written by pm-spec in stage 3, in specs/changes/<name>/tickets.json. It names no ticket system; mapping it into one is the reader's job.

id.description: Local and stable across runs: the change name for the epic (or the one task of a change with one component), <change>/<component> for a component's task.

parent.description: The id of the parent item; null for the epic, and for the one task of a change with one component.

acceptance.description: A checklist: the numbered criteria of the component's plan, under ## Done means.

ref.description: The item's ticket, as an opaque string: the change's (--ticket-ref) for the epic or the one task, and a component's (--ticket-child, or resume --ticket <component>=<REF>) once it has one.
